title: Fleet Management: integration test suite (Plan 20 gap 3)
description:
Implement the fleet-specific integration test suite from Plan 20 §11.2. Should be build-tag gated. The fleet code has unit tests but no integration test suite exercising the full control loop with provisioning, routing, and lifecycle.

Key deliverables:
- Build-tag gated integration test suite
- Control loop integration scenarios
- Provisioning + routing end-to-end tests
- Mock AWS/SSM backends for test isolation

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/20-fleet-management.md §11.2
- Code: internal/sandbox/control/fleet/
